limits.description: Real Stripe test-mode acceptance requires the repository secret STRIPE_TEST_SECRET_KEY and cannot be replaced by deterministic adapter tests, fake providers, mocked fetches or a skipped sandbox test.
The repository migration model is forward-only. Recovery evidence uses owner-local snapshot restore plus exact forward reapply rather than down migrations.
WP06 reliability evidence is non-production rehearsal evidence and does not perform or authorize production traffic cutover.
Operations Console and Gateway route governed inspection/commands to owner domains; they do not become a universal commercial truth database and cannot invent owner status.
Reliability acceptance does not itself appoint a provider/professional, submit a filing, create Official Truth or execute another protected external action.
Green CI, a passing WP06 matrix or a passing independent audit does not auto-merge, auto-release or authorize production deployment.
